Class AuthenticationService

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.patientportal.service.AuthenticationService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AuthenticationManagementService
@Service public class AuthenticationService extends Object implements AuthenticationManagementService
Service responsible for handling authentication and JWT-related operations.

This service provides functionality for:

  • User authentication (login)
  • JWT token generation
  • JWT token validation
  • Extracting user identity from tokens

Authentication Flow:

  1. Retrieve user by username
  2. Validate password using PasswordEncoder
  3. Update user's last login timestamp
  4. Generate JWT token via TokenService
  5. Return LoginResponse containing token and user details

Security Notes:

  • Passwords are securely stored using hashing (e.g., BCrypt)
  • JWT tokens are stateless and time-limited
  • Invalid credentials result in UnauthorizedException

  • Method Details

    • login

      public LoginResponse login(LoginRequest loginRequest)
      Authenticates a user and generates a JWT token.

      This method performs the following:

      • Validates that the user exists
      • Compares raw password with stored hashed password
      • Updates last login timestamp
      • Generates a JWT token
      Specified by:
      login in interface AuthenticationManagementService
      Parameters:
      loginRequest - contains username and password
      Returns:
      LoginResponse containing user info and JWT token
      Throws:
      UnauthorizedException - if credentials are invalid

      public boolean validateToken(String token)

      This method checks whether a token is:

      Parameters:

      Returns:

      public String getUsernameFromToken(String token)
      Extracts the username from a JWT token.

      This is typically used to identify the currently authenticated user during request processing.

      Parameters:

      username embedded in the token
